id: title:adboio:scope agent generations to selected project

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the PostHog Agent integration by establishing a project-scoped authentication header, replacing the removed team_id-based header. This allows the Claude gateway to distinguish requests belonging to specific PostHog projects, potentially supporting billing attribution or project-specific access control.
review.reason: The change replaces a team_id-based property header with a project-scoped header and adds a shared header builder. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement for the Agent integration, demonstrating a shift from team-level to project-level identification. review.uncertainty: The actual realization of billing attribution or access control benefits depends on downstream gateway implementation and is not independently verified by this frontend change. No production incident or adoption is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new shared header builder and its usage; removes the team_id-based property header, replaces it with a project-scoped header; updates comments and adds a test.
observations.posthog_connection: The agent adapter now explicitly passes the selected project ID to the Claude gateway, while the gateway authenticates using that project ID. This could help PostHog distinguish which project a request belongs to, potentially supporting billing attribution or project-specific access control.
